book: Agrawal ExamCart, SSB OIR, Reasoning section
scans: SSR OIR 1-127 (phone photos of printed pages 1-127)
title: Calender and Clock
note: Verbatim, typos included ("Calender", "become an adult", "it be on", "minutes hand", "minute hands points"). Never edited: corrections live in src/items/oir/. Ordinals print with superscript suffixes, transcribed inline; fractions print stacked (39 6/11, 12½). The chapter prints no direction. Q43's minute count sits on the page curl and reads 38. Q32 names a character whose book name matches a real candidate's and is replaced (D27).
